newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl and Kloeckner break off cooperation talks.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl and Kloeckner break off cooperation talks.

text.p: Austria's VA Stahl AG said on Tuesday talks with Germany's Kloeckner & Co to seal a steel trading cooperation deal had failed.
"The reason why talks failed were differences over the evaluation of the companies questioned", VA Stahl said in a statement.
"The failure of the talks have no impact on current cooperation in different operative fields," VA Stahl said.

Under the deal Kloeckner would have taken over the majority of Voest-Alpine Stahlhandel AG, the trading unit of Voest-Alpine Stahl Linz GmbH, while VA Stahl would have acquired two of Kloeckner's steel service centres in Switzerland.
VA Stahl was poised to continue its strategy to strengthen its processing activities.
All the group's activities in Austria, Germany, Italy and France would in future be concentrated in a new Voest-Alpine Stahl Service Center GmbH, the company said.
VA Stahl was also aiming for new strategic partners in this field in neighbouring countries.
VA Stahl said its unit Stahlhandel AG would continue its normal trading activities but would also concentrate on markets in Central Europe.
